from collections import defaultdict

N = int(input())
beans = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(N)]

# Group beans by color and find the minimum deliciousness for each color
color_to_min_deliciousness = defaultdict(lambda: float('inf'))
for deliciousness, color in beans:
    if deliciousness < color_to_min_deliciousness[color]:
        color_to_min_deliciousness[color] = deliciousness

# Find the maximum of the minimum deliciousness values
result = max(color_to_min_deliciousness.values())
print(result)
